videos.scope: 以矽橋作為異質晶粒互連案例，對照整片中介層的空間配置。

watchFor: 辨認互連橋位於哪些相鄰晶粒之間。

思考晶粒邊緣 I/O 位置對可連接性的限制。

Separate the jobs of package substrate and fine-pitch interconnect.
Consider how die-edge I/O placement constrains connectivity.
videos.before: 畫出兩顆邏輯晶粒與一組記憶體；先標示最需要高頻寬的連線。

videos.after: 提出一版橋接配置及一版中介層配置，說明需要哪些電性、良率和成本資料才能選擇。
videos.afterEn: Propose one bridge layout and one interposer layout; state the electrical, yield and cost data needed to choose between them.

guides.title: 先畫資料流，再決定中介層或矽橋
guides.titleEn: Map data flow before choosing an interposer or bridge
guides.concept: 先進封裝把不同功能晶粒連成系統。中介層、局部矽橋及垂直堆疊提供不同的連接幾何；選擇必須同時考慮 I/O 位置、連線密度、供電、熱、測試和組裝條件。品牌名稱不是可以互換的配方。
guides.conceptEn: Advanced packaging connects functional dies into a system. Interposers, local silicon bridges and vertical stacking offer different connection geometries. Choices depend on I/O placement, connection density, power, heat, testing and assembly conditions together; brand names are not interchangeable recipes.
procedure: 選一個教學系統，例如邏輯晶粒加高頻寬記憶體，畫出功能與資料方向。為每條連接記錄資料率的定義、方向、通道數和時脈假設；未知值保持未知。
畫兩種平面配置：一種以較廣的中介層連接，另一種只在相鄰晶粒邊緣配置局部橋。用不同顏色標示高速訊號、電源與低速控制線。
檢查每條重要路徑是否能到達正確的 I/O 邊界，是否存在交叉、繞路或間距衝突。不能只把方塊靠近就假定走線容量足夠。
在配置圖加上熱源、可能的冷卻路徑與測試存取點。提出一個為減少走線而移動晶粒、卻使熱或測試變差的例子，練習共同設計的取捨。
建立比較表，將幾何可行性、電性模型、組裝對準、已知良品晶粒與供應鏈限制分欄。對沒有可追溯成本或良率資料的方案，只做條件式結論。
procedureEn: Choose an educational system such as a logic die with high-bandwidth memory and map functions and data directions. For each link, record rate definition, direction, lane count and clock assumptions; preserve unknown values.
Draw two floorplans: a broader interposer and local bridges at adjacent die edges. Color high-speed signals, power and low-speed control separately.
Check whether each important path reaches the correct I/O boundary and encounters crossing, detour or spacing conflicts. Placing blocks close together does not establish adequate routing capacity.
Add heat sources, possible cooling paths and test access. Give an example where moving a die to reduce routing worsens heat removal or testability, exposing a co-design tradeoff.

Compare geometric feasibility, electrical models, assembly alignment, known-good-die evidence and supply constraints in separate columns. Make only conditional conclusions without traceable cost or yield data.
evidence: 提交兩張配置圖、一張介面清單與條件式比較表。每條重要連接都應有起點、終點、方向和待驗證項目。
解釋兩種配置各有何限制，並指出資料尚不足時不宜宣稱哪種一定更便宜或更快。
evidenceEn: Submit two floorplans, an interface register and a conditional comparison. Every important connection should have endpoints, direction and an unresolved verification item.
Explain constraints of both layouts and why missing data prevents unconditional claims of lower cost or higher speed.
pitfalls: 把 EMIB、CoWoS 和 SoIC 視為同一種結構。
只比較平面面積，忽略基板、供電、冷卻及測試。
把示意圖上的連線當成已完成訊號完整性分析。
pitfallsEn: Treating EMIB, CoWoS and SoIC as the same structure.
Comparing footprint alone while ignoring substrate, power, cooling and testing.
Treating lines in a drawing as completed signal-integrity analysis.

sources.title: Video: Intel EMIB Technology Explained | Intel

guides.scope: 原創教學工作單；使用本網站示意圖，並自行準備或從所列來源取得圖表、量測或模擬資料。沒有提供晶圓廠製程配方，也沒有內建本題的實測資料。
guides.scopeEn: Original educational worksheet. Use the site schematics and figures, measurements or simulation data you supply or obtain from the references. This is not a foundry recipe, and no measured dataset for this exercise is bundled.

guides.title: 3D 堆疊：一起追蹤熱路徑、互連與可測試性
guides.titleEn: 3D stacking: trace heat paths, interconnects and testability together
guides.concept: 垂直堆疊縮短部分連接並增加整合密度，同時改變熱路徑、接合界面與測試方式。單顆晶粒測試通過，不代表接合後沒有缺陷；連接密度提高也不代表熱限制自然消失。
guides.conceptEn: Vertical stacking shortens some connections and increases integration density while changing heat paths, bonding interfaces and test methods. A die passing standalone tests does not prove a defect-free assembled stack, and denser connections do not remove thermal constraints.
procedure: 畫出兩層晶粒、接合界面、封裝基板與散熱面的剖面。將訊號、供電和熱三種路徑分開追蹤，並標示哪個路徑是教學假設。
建立簡化熱阻網路，先用 ΔT ≈ P × Rθ 觀察單一熱源的趨勢。加入第二層熱源時，註明互相加熱和三維擴散需要更完整模型，不把各層獨立溫升直接相加當作精確答案。
在接合界面畫出未對準、局部未接合與電性開路三種可能。分別提出位置觀察、界面觀察及電性連續性測試；說明它們能支持但不能互相取代的結論。
安排接合前、接合後、最終組裝後三個測試關卡，記錄各關卡可接觸哪些節點、能發現哪些故障。把未測到的故障保留在風險表，不把已知良品晶粒當作零風險。
提出一版重新安排熱源或調整測試存取的方案，列出它對佈線與組裝的副作用。以證據完整性比較方案，而不是只選剖面看起來最密集的版本。
procedureEn: Draw two die tiers, the bonding interface, package substrate and cooling surface in cross-section. Trace signal, power and heat separately and identify educational assumptions.

Build a simplified thermal-resistance network and use ΔT ≈ P × Rθ to inspect a single-source trend. With a second heat source, state that mutual heating and three-dimensional spreading need a fuller model; do not sum isolated temperature rises as an exact result.

Illustrate misalignment, local nonbonding and electrical opens at the interface. Propose positional, interface and continuity observations, explaining which conclusions each can support without substituting one for another.

Schedule prebond, postbond and post-assembly test gates. Record accessible nodes and detectable faults at each stage. Retain untested fault classes in a risk table; known-good die does not mean zero assembly risk.
Propose a revised heat-source arrangement or test-access scheme and list side effects on routing and assembly. Compare evidence completeness rather than selecting the visually densest cross-section.
evidence: 交付三路徑剖面、熱模型假設表，以及「故障類型→檢查方法→可判斷與不可判斷事項」對照表。
驗收是能說清楚最弱的證據環節及下一個需要的測試；本工作單不等同產品可靠度認證。
evidenceEn: Deliver a three-path cross-section, thermal-model assumptions and a fault-to-observation table stating what can and cannot be concluded.
Acceptance means identifying the weakest evidence link and the next needed test; this worksheet is not product reliability qualification.
pitfalls: 把薄化晶粒一律視為更冷或更可靠。
用單一影像推論所有互連都導通。
把廠商特定堆疊世代的參數混在同一個模型。
pitfallsEn: Assuming thinner dies are always cooler or more reliable.
Inferring all interconnects conduct from one image.
Mixing parameters from different vendor-specific stacking generations.

sources.title: Intel Leads the Way with Advanced Packaging | Intel
Cutting-edge Process Technologies for Data Center | Intel

guides.scope: 原創教學工作單；使用本網站示意圖，並自行準備或從所列來源取得圖表、量測或模擬資料。沒有提供晶圓廠製程配方，也沒有內建本題的實測資料。
guides.scopeEn: Original educational worksheet. Use the site schematics and figures, measurements or simulation data you supply or obtain from the references. This is not a foundry recipe, and no measured dataset for this exercise is bundled.

guides.title: 先進封裝共同設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Advanced Packaging Co-Design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 將晶粒、互連、基板與散熱責任分開。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Separate die, interconnect, substrate and cooling responsibilities. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：將晶粒、互連、基板與散熱責任分開。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以功耗、頻寬及接點數建立介面表。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Separate die, interconnect, substrate and cooling responsibilities. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Build an interface table with power, bandwidth and connection count. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以功耗、頻寬及接點數建立介面表」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Build an interface table with power, bandwidth and connection count, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

sources.title: AIM Photonics: Test, Assembly and Packaging

guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: 先進封裝共同設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Advanced Packaging Co-Design: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨識封裝功能邊界」建立判讀邊界。封裝同時承擔電連接、散熱與保護。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify package functions to define the interpretation boundary. Packaging provides connection, heat removal and protection. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識封裝功能邊界：每條跨區連線都有訊號或熱的角色；保留可重現判讀所需的原始圖像、量測或流程圖。
觀察站 2｜TSV 深寬比核對：觀察重點：幾何位於已核准設備能力範圍；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
觀察站 3｜產品測試與譜系移交：觀察重點：交付狀態與所有識別資料一致；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify package functions: Every crossing has an electrical or thermal role; retain the original image, measurement or process map needed to reproduce the assessment.
Observation station 2 | Check TSV aspect ratio: Observable evidence: Geometry falls within the approved tool capability. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
Observation station 3 | Handoff product test and genealogy: Observable evidence: Delivery status agrees with all identifiers. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「TSV 深寬比核對」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「產品測試與譜系移交」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Check TSV aspect ratio: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Handoff product test and genealogy to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 把板級功能算入晶粒會漏掉封裝介面。
入口寬度代替最窄處會低估填孔難度。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Assigning board functions to the die hides package interfaces.
Using entrance width hides the narrowest fill restriction. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

related.transfer: 縮小互連節距可提高接點密度；縮短垂直連線有助降低互連電阻與損失，但仍需共同評估接合、散熱、測試與良率。
related.transferEn: Finer interconnect pitch increases connection density; shorter vertical connections can reduce interconnect resistance and loss, while bonding, heat removal, testing and yield still need joint assessment.
related.difference: 混合接合是封裝整合的一種界面技術；先進封裝還包含中介層、基板、外部接點及多種不同連接方式。
related.differenceEn: Hybrid bonding is one integration-interface technology; advanced packaging also includes interposers, substrates, external terminals and other connection methods.
practice: 在封裝剖面圈出混合接合界面
追蹤一條訊號與一條熱流路徑
比較接合前與接合後可做的測試
practiceEn: Identify the hybrid-bond interface in a package section
Trace one signal path and one heat-flow path
Compare tests available before and after bonding

related.transfer: 封裝和光引擎都要協調晶片、基板、散熱與測試，介面品質決定整體良率。
related.transferEn: Packaging and optical engines coordinate chips, substrates, cooling and testing; interface quality shapes overall yield.
related.difference: 一般電性封裝以電連接為核心；矽光子還加入波導、光纖與光學耦合，不能只用導通測試判斷成功。
related.differenceEn: Electrical packaging centers on electrical connections; silicon photonics adds waveguides, fibers and optical coupling, so continuity tests alone cannot establish success.
practice: 在封裝剖面分色電與光
比較接點電阻和耦合損耗
列出組裝前後各可驗證的介面
practiceEn: Color-code electrical and optical package paths
Compare contact resistance and coupling loss
List interfaces testable before and after assembly

courses.summary:
日月光於 1984 年在高雄開始第一座工廠的營運，之後把封裝與測試能力逐步整合。其歷史中的測試市場擴展與覆晶封裝量產，提供了一條從晶粒到可用電子元件的學習線索：晶圓製成後，工程工作並沒有結束。

本課程以楠梓的高雄園區作為代表地點，討論晶粒連接、散熱、機械支撐與測試如何共同決定封裝成效。地圖不代表所有先進封裝都在這裡製造；不同封裝架構與產品資格仍須分別驗證，也不能把企業里程碑當成每項產品的詳細流程。
courses.summaryEn:
ASE began operations at its first Kaohsiung factory in 1984 and subsequently expanded the combination of assembly and test capabilities. Its entry into semiconductor testing and volume flip-chip packaging offer a path from a bare die to a usable electronic component: engineering does not end when wafer fabrication finishes.

The course uses the Kaohsiung campus in Nanzih as a representative place for studying electrical connection, heat transfer, mechanical support, and test. The pin does not imply that all advanced packaging is manufactured there. Different architectures and product qualifications remain separate, and corporate milestones do not disclose detailed product flows.

history.textEn: ASE’s history records volume flip-chip production, providing a milestone for comparing wire-bond and area-array interconnect approaches.

courses.connection: 把高雄封測聚落連到課程的共同設計：在同一示意封裝中追蹤訊號、電源、熱量與機械應力，並指出每條路徑需要的驗證證據。
courses.connectionEn: Connect the Kaohsiung assembly-and-test cluster to co-design: trace signals, power, heat, and mechanical stress through one illustrative package and identify evidence for each path.
